label: ДДС registration-threshold package still not in parliament (€51,130 → €60,000 plan unfiled)
text: БСК's finance-bill tracker (discussion opened 26.10, run until 12.11) lists as tabled only the ЗПС and Фискален съвет amendments from МС and the Валутен закон amendment; the only ЗДДС bills remain opposition ones from 23 September, so the finance ministry's phased €51,130 → €60,000 (2027) → €70,000 (2028) → €75,000 (2029) threshold path is not on the register at all.
